=== PARKED da84 AND 77e7 at operator request ===

Both agents stopped. Progress preserved; both tickets carry a full parked-state comment.

da84-924e-0f49-470a (occasional-handsewn-finch) - FURTHEST ALONG.
  Worktree /Users/joeoakhart/impl-da84, branch impl-da84, tree CLEAN.
  Commit 64a5f5b83de 'One quarantine mover for merge recovery' pushed as Gerrit 2113.
  Votes: LLM-Review +1, Verified pending. Attestation certified. 4 ACs unticked/unverified.
  Resume = check 2113's votes, submit if green, verify the 4 ACs on their own commands, reconcile file_impact, close.

77e7-1eec-7b52-46ed (dormant-fibre-pterosaurs) - EARLIER.
  Worktree /Users/joeoakhart/impl-77e7, branch impl-77e7, tree CLEAN.
  Its work was UNCOMMITTED when stopped (16 dirty files); I ran the gates first, found them clean, and committed it as 4b9ca707880 'Validate caused_by targets before recording' (+454/-76, incl. new tests/unit/test_caused_by_link_validation.py) so a stray checkout could not lose it. NOT pushed - no Gerrit change exists.
  Verified before committing: make lint, make typecheck (630 files), complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0, and 50 tests green across the new suite, the inbound-applier suite and write-parity. Nothing beyond that.
  NOT done: 8 ACs unverified, file_impact unreconciled, no mutation evidence, never reviewed.

Both left in_progress deliberately: real claimed work exists in each, so in_progress is the honest status - they are parked, not abandoned. Reverting them to open would misrepresent a clean slate and drop the claim.

EPIC 2ddd FINAL STATE THIS SESSION: 20 of 23 children closed. Remaining three: 3436 (Gerrit 2098, LLM-Review +1, Verified pending after the orphaned fault-injection seam fix), plus these two parked.

The single most repeated failure of the run, for whoever picks this up: SIX tickets were refused at the close gate for a file_impact that did not match the landed diff (1cf6, 7931, a73e, d6e3, 1dd5, 73b8). Scope, file_impact and the real diff are maintained independently and nothing reconciles them until the close gate does. Run rebar set-file-impact from the actual diff AFTER implementation, every time.
